headline: **MLB Daily Recap**
article:
The Minnesota Twins fell to the Cleveland Guardians in a 5-2 loss, with Ryan Jeffers leading the Twins' offense. The Los Angeles Dodgers edged out the Philadelphia Phillies 2-1, with Max Muncy leading the offense and Justin Wrobleski earning the win. The Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Toronto Blue Jays, securing a 12-2 victory with Nick Fortes leading the offense.

Several players have been affected by injuries, including Jonatan Clase, who was placed on the 10-day injured list by the Toronto Blue Jays due to left plantar fasciitis. The Baltimore Orioles also placed Samuel Basallo on the 10-day injured list due to right shoulder inflammation. The Kansas City Royals transferred Stephen Kolek to the 60-day injured list with a right flexor strain and placed Bobby Witt Jr. on the 10-day injured list with low back tightness.

The Los Angeles Dodgers acquired Seth Halvorsen from the Colorado Rockies in exchange for Nick Frasso and Landyn Vidourek. The Houston Astros traded Nate Pearson to the Kansas City Royals for Max Martin. The Athletics traded Aaron Civale to the Chicago Cubs for Aiden Moffett, and the Kansas City Royals traded Rudy Martin Jr. to the Baltimore Orioles for cash.

top_news.title: **Twins Fall to Guardians in 5-2 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins suffered a 5-2 defeat at the hands of the Cleveland Guardians. Ryan Jeffers led the Twins' offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Take Down Phillies in Thrilling 2-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers edged out the Philadelphia Phillies 2-1, with Max Muncy leading the offense and Justin Wrobleski earning the win.

top_news.title: **Rays Cruise Past Blue Jays 12-2**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Toronto Blue Jays, securing a 12-2 victory. Nick Fortes led the offense with a 3-hit, 4-RBI performance, including a home run.

top_news.title: **Padres Take Down Braves 8-3**
top_news.summary: The San Diego Padres secured an 8-3 victory over the Atlanta Braves, with Manny Machado leading the charge at the plate. Machado hit two home runs and drove in two runs in the game.

top_news.title: **Pirates Pull Off Upset in Bronx**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 5-3 victory over the New York Yankees, snapping their winning streak. Impact players for the Pirates included Jake Mangum, Nick Gonzales, Jacob Gonzalez, and Ben Rice, while Mitch Keller led the pitching effort.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Take Down Orioles 6-3**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox secured a 6-3 win over the Baltimore Orioles in their latest matchup. Impact hitters for the game included Pete Alonso, Christian Encarnacion-Strand, Jackson Holliday, Ceddanne Rafaela, Willson Contreras, and Caleb Durbin.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays' Clase Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Toronto Blue Jays left fielder Jonatan Clase has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to left plantar fasciitis, effective retroactive to July 21, 2026.

top_news.title: **Astros Acquire RHP Max Martin in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros have made a move to bolster their pitching staff, acquiring right-handed pitcher Max Martin in a trade. Martin joins the Astros after being dealt from the Kansas City Royals.
